The authorization control evaluates the runtime request doer through its administrator, username, and repository-administrator properties; the supplied principal facts bind the declared caller to the non-site-admin, non-repository-admin doer with a different username.
The selected collaborator resource is bound from the request path username and is used to load the collaborator account before the permission lookup.

The gate checks the request doer and its relation to the selected username, while the later permission operation targets the loaded collaborator and repository; ownership or properties of the doer are not themselves the repository permission resource.

Before the collaborator lookup, the entry denies when the doer is not a site administrator, the username is not the doer's own username, and the doer is not a repository administrator; the denial is HTTP 403 and returns immediately.

The source-visible bypass branches are site-administrator status, case-insensitive self-username equality, or repository-administrator status; these are the only exceptions shown by this entry-local control.

Under the supplied condition that the caller username differs from the collaborator username and the caller is neither a site administrator nor a repository administrator, none of the visible exception branches applies.
The protected repository-permission query is performed only after collaborator loading and invokes the individual-user repository-permission operation for the selected collaborator.
A successful permission result is serialized only after the permission query completes; the denied branch returns before either the query or success response.
